data.name: Sontosh
data.gender_notes: Sontosh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sontosh is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Santosh’, which means contentment, satisfaction and happiness. The name is believed to bestow the blessings of Lord Vishnu, the preserver of the universe and the deity of happiness and prosperity. The name Sontosh carries the meaning “God of Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sontosh usually hope their child will grow to embody god of wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Sontosh is a powerful invocation of the divine presence of Lord Vishnu, who is believed to bestow contentment, happiness and wisdom upon his devotees.
data.etymology: Sontosh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Wisdom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sontosh total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

Naming a child with this moniker is considered auspicious as it signifies the desire to imbue the child with the inherent qualities of contentment and happiness. The name carries a profound meaning, symbolizing the deep-rooted Indian values emphasizing inner peace and contentment.
data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, the name Sontosh is revered and believed to invoke the blessings of Lord Vishnu. In Hinduism, Lord Vishnu is the preserver of the universe and the deity of happiness and prosperity. Bestowing a child with this name is believed to invoke Lord Vishnu's blessings and instill in the child the qualities of happiness, contentment, and peace.
